name: GECAA
postCreateCommand: pip install -e '.[dev,heat,stac,ogc,hydraulics,sewer]' && (setsid nohup bash -c 'bash services/climada_worker/install.sh; bash services/lisflood_worker/install.sh; python scripts/prepare_zensus.py' < /dev/null > /tmp/gecaa_setup.log 2>&1 &)

postAttachCommand.climada: bash -c 'for i in $(seq 1 120); do [ -x $HOME/.venvs/gecaa-climada/bin/uvicorn ] && exec bash services/climada_worker/run.sh; sleep 10; done'
postAttachCommand.lisflood: bash -c 'for i in $(seq 1 180); do [ -x $HOME/.local/lisflood/bin/lisflood ] && exec bash services/lisflood_worker/run.sh; sleep 10; done'
